correctness.rationale: Brute-force re-enumeration for n<=7 (all n! perms, direct pattern test) reproduces candidate tri_123 and tri_132 tables cell-for-cell. Catalan marginals 1,1,2,5,14,42,132,429,1430,4862,16796 hold for both patterns to n=10. fp<=2 holds for every 123 cell (Elizalde Sec 3.1 constraint). des marginals match exact-rational expansion of Barnabei Thm-6 E(x,y) termwise n=0..10 (independently recomputed; n<=7 rows match Barnabei printed table, e.g. n=7 {3:56,4:252,5:120,6:1}). Krattenthaler LTR-min map reimplemented independently and verified Dyck-valid with des=valleys+triple-falls on every 123-avoider for n<=7; candidate per-object flags dyck_ok=replay_ok=True to n=10 are consistent with that verified code path. Minimal divergence witnesses at n=3 confirmed by hand: S3(123)={132,213,231,312,321} has two (1,1,1) perms (132,213) vs S3(132) has one (213) plus identity (3,0,0). Incremental O(k) pruning logic inspected and sound (123: middle j with min-before<cur[j]<cur[k]; 132: min-before<cur[k]<cur[j]); no closed trivariate GF is claimed. Minor non-material slip: DRAFT states total objects 23715; correct sum_{n<=10} C_n is 23714.

originality.rationale: Elizalde math/0311211 abstract and paper state all multi-pattern (fp,exc) cases solved but single patterns only partial; Sec 3.1 for 123 gives at most two fixed points and summation formulas with no des variable and no closed F_123. Barnabei arXiv:0910.0963 abstract plus full text (Prop 1, Thms 5-6, table to n=7) records only the Eulerian des marginal E(x,y)=A(x,y,y) via des=valleys+triple-falls; no (exc,des), (fp,des), or (fp,exc,des) joint appears. Fu-Lin-Wang 2009.04269 uses Comtet statistics (comp,iar) with (des,iar,comp) GFs, leaving classical (fp,exc,des) for 123 untouched. Reifegerste treats 321/bi-increasing; Hoffman et al. give only fixed-point asymptotics. Joints are not mechanically implied by combining an fp-formula marginal with a des marginal. Internal SCOPE scan shows no overlap (closest SCOPE039 is LIS/Narayana over 231-avoiders). Hence trivariate tables, both bivariate joints, rows n=8-10, and 572-cell 123-vs-132 divergence list are substantively new.

value.rationale: Headline result judged separately from the open trivariate GF: complete certified N_{n,k,j,d}(123) for n<=10 with (exc,des)/(fp,des) joints, per-object Krattenthaler-Dyck des certificate, termwise Barnabei GF match (new Eulerian rows n=8,9,10), and explicit 572-cell divergence vs settled 132 law with minimal witness at n=3. Object (single pattern 123) and invariant (classical fp/exc/des joint) were motivated before computation as Elizalde's explicitly open single-pattern case plus Barnabei's des marginal; values were not known or mechanically implied. A future researcher in refined-Wilf/Catalan/stack-sortable studies could reasonably need the exact joint cells, new Eulerian rows, or minimal separating cells. Natural full-Catalan scope to n=10, honestly described as finite fallback census with no general-n formula claimed. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained arbitrary enumeration.
